docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,500.00 FILED BY BITTEL TELECOMMUNICATIONS AS TO DEFENDANT ADAPTIVE VIDEO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-27-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 03
